info.description: The Shadeform API. This document describes a subset of the `/v1` surface and is expanding; a route that is absent here is not necessarily absent from the API.
info.title: Shadeform API

get.description: The instances on the caller's account. Deleted instances are returned only when `status=deleted`, and that view omits instances that belong to a cluster and hides connection details. Pagination is optional: without `limit` or `offset` the whole list is returned.

parameters.description: Only instances in this status. `deleted` selects the deletion history instead of the live list.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Match instances whose name, id or address contains this text.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Page size. Between 1 and 100; defaults to 50 when either pagination parameter is given.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many instances to skip. Requires a non-negative integer.
parameters.name: offset

400.description: A query parameter was rejected. The body is the reason - which parameter, and what it accepts. Plain text.

404.description: Plain-text body. Reachable only through the shared lookup; a list with no matches is an empty array and a 200.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Creates an instance and returns its id. The call is asynchronous: the instance comes back in `creating` and is provisioned afterwards, so poll `GET /v1/instances/{instance_id}/info` for its status. The cloud, region and instance type must name an available combination from `GET /v1/instances/types`.

400.description: The body could not be read, or names a cloud that does not exist. Plain-text body.

404.description: A template, SSH key or volume named in the request is not on this account. Plain-text body.

409.description: The operation was refused, or the instance is not in a state that allows it. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`. One case, restarting an instance that is not active, answers 409 with no body at all.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: The public catalog of instance types across every listed cloud, with per-region availability. A SKU with a published spot price lists a second entry per region tagged `rental_type=spot` alongside its `on_demand` entry.

parameters.description: Only return instance types on this cloud (case-insensitive).
parameters.name: cloud

parameters.description: Only return availability entries in this Shade region (case-insensitive). Instance types left with no matching region are dropped from the response entirely.
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: A non-zero value returns only instance types with exactly that GPU count. 0 disables the filter, and so does omitting the parameter - the two are indistinguishable, so this filter cannot select instance types with no GPUs.
parameters.name: num_gpus

parameters.description: Only return instance types with this GPU type (case-insensitive).
parameters.name: gpu_type

parameters.description: Only return this Shade instance type (case-insensitive).
parameters.name: shade_instance_type

parameters.description: "true" keeps only available entries, "false" only unavailable ones. Any other value is ignored.
parameters.name: available

parameters.description: Ordering, not filtering: "price" sorts ascending by on-demand hourly price, removing nothing. Any other value is ignored.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: "true" excludes the hyperscalers (AWS, Azure). Any other value is ignored.
parameters.name: shade_cloud

400.description: The request was rejected before the handler ran: a query or path parameter that could not be bound.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. `detail` is omitted: the underlying error is logged, never returned.

post.description: Marks the instance for deletion and returns. The provider-side delete is performed asynchronously by the InstanceDeleter daemon, so a 200 means the request was accepted, not that the instance is gone.

400.description: The instance id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such instance on this account. Plain-text body.

409.description: The operation was refused, or the instance is not in a state that allows it. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`. One case, restarting an instance that is not active, answers 409 with no body at all.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: Returns one instance on the caller's account. A deleted instance is still returned, with its connection details removed and its final cost filled in.

400.description: The instance id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such instance on this account. Plain-text body.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Restarts a running instance through its cloud provider. Only an `active` instance can be restarted, and a commitment instance cannot.

400.description: The instance's cloud could not be resolved. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such instance on this account. Plain-text body.

409.description: The operation was refused, or the instance is not in a state that allows it. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`. One case, restarting an instance that is not active, answers 409 with no body at all.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Changes an instance's name, tags, auto-delete thresholds and alert thresholds. Only the fields present in the body are touched: sending a field as `null` clears it, and leaving it out leaves it as it was. On a commitment instance the auto-delete and alert fields are ignored rather than refused, because that instance is not billed hourly.

400.description: The instance id is not a valid UUID, or the body could not be read. The body is the reason. Plain text.

404.description: No such instance on this account. Plain-text body.

409.description: The operation was refused, or the instance is not in a state that allows it. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`. One case, restarting an instance that is not active, answers 409 with no body at all.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Queues a new model configuration for an instance launched to serve a model. The agent on the instance applies it, so a 200 means the change was accepted and returns the id of the queued entry. Only instances launched with a model configuration accept this.

400.description: The instance id in the path is not a valid UUID, or the body could not be read. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such instance on this account. Plain-text body.

409.description: The operation was refused, or the instance is not in a state that allows it. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`. One case, restarting an instance that is not active, answers 409 with no body at all.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: Every SSH key on the caller's account. A key added with a private key returns that private key here, so this response is secret material.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Stores an SSH public key on the caller's account, optionally with its private key so that it can be returned later. The key is added as a non-default key whatever the account already holds; use the set-default route to change which key is the default.

400.description: The body could not be read, or the key could not be stored. Plain-text body.

409.description: The operation was refused. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. `detail` is omitted: the underlying error is logged, never returned.

post.description: Deletes one SSH key from the caller's account. A key is refused while it is the account default, while it is attached to an instance that is not deleted, and always for the Shadeform-managed key; the reason is in the response body. Returns an empty object.

400.description: The SSH key id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such SSH key on this account. Plain-text body.

409.description: The operation was refused. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: Returns one SSH key on the caller's account, including its private key if one was stored with it.

400.description: The SSH key id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such SSH key on this account. Plain-text body.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Makes this key the account's default, which is the key an instance is created with when none is named. Returns an empty object.

400.description: The SSH key id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such SSH key on this account. Plain-text body.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: The templates on the caller's account. Templates published by other accounts are not listed here; see the featured route.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: The templates Shadeform publishes for every account to launch from. The caller's own templates are not included; see the template list.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Stores a template on the caller's account and returns its id. The name is required, must be under 100 characters, and may contain only letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and underscores.

400.description: The body could not be read, or the template is not valid. The body is the reason - which field, and what is wrong with it. Plain text.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Deletes a template from the caller's account.

400.description: The template id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such template on this account. Plain-text body.

get.description: Returns one template: either the caller's own, or one published for every account. `is_account_owner` says which, and is absent for a template that has no owning account.

400.description: The template id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such template on this account. Plain-text body.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

put.description: Replaces a template the caller owns. The whole template is sent, not a patch: a field left out is cleared. Published templates owned by another account cannot be updated.

400.description: The body could not be read, or the template is not valid. The body is the reason - which field, and what is wrong with it. Plain text.

404.description: No such template on this account. Plain-text body.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: Every volume on the caller's account, with the instances currently mounting each one.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Creates a volume with the provider and returns its id. The call is synchronous: a 200 means the volume exists. `size_in_gb` is required and must be at least 50; it is checked before the cloud and region are read, so omitting it is refused whatever the cloud.

400.description: The body could not be read, or names a cloud that does not exist or cannot be reached. Plain-text body.

409.description: The volume was refused: too little account balance, a size the cloud does not accept, or no volume type for that cloud and region. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: The volume types available per cloud and region, with the per-GB hourly price and whether the size is fixed. A cloud and region absent here cannot host a volume.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

post.description: Deletes one volume from the caller's account. A volume is refused while any instance still mounts it; delete those instances first. Deleting a volume that is already gone succeeds.

200.description: The volume was deleted, or was already gone.

400.description: The volume id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such volume on this account. Plain-text body.

409.description: The volume is still mounted by at least one instance. The body names the reason in `error`, with a machine-readable `error_code`.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

get.description: Returns one volume on the caller's account, with the instances currently mounting it.

400.description: The volume id in the path is not a valid UUID. Plain-text body.

404.description: No such volume on this account. Plain-text body.

500.description: The request failed inside the service. Plain-text body.

name.description: For example, name of the parameter that caused the error

type.description: URL of the error type. Can be used to lookup the error in a documentation

ApiKeyAuth.description: An API key issued from the Shadeform dashboard. Routes that accept a key also accept an Auth0 bearer token in `Authorization`, which this document does not describe.
ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-KEY
